summary:
# NOTES: The Man From Bar 20 (Clarence E. Mulford, Gutenberg #56154)

Single book, no BOOK headings. Frontispiece by Frank E. Schoonover. Publisher A. L. Burt (1918). Dedication: "Affectionately Dedicated to E. V. A." Preceded by Gutenberg boilerplate and a Burt catalog of other titles (ignore).

## Characters
- **Johnny Nelson** ("Dearly Beloved", "Kid"): protagonist, two-gun man from Bar-20 (Texas) / Tin Cup (Montana). 30 yrs old, 5'10", 160 lbs, blue eyes, brown hair. Ambidextrous. Wooden-handled flare-butt Frontier Colts, tied down. Sharp's Special rifle. Horse: black mare **Pepper**. Pet: parrot **Andrew Jackson "Andy"** (at Pop's). Friends: Hopalong Cassidy (married Mary, son William Junior), Red Connors (married, wife Rose?), Buck (married), Skinny, Lanky, Pete Wilson, Tex Ewalt, Youbet Somes (dead), Billy Atwood, Mary (Hopalong's wife). William Cassidy Senior writes letter.
- **John C. Logan**: foreman/owner of CL ranch, Deepwater Valley. Friend of Johnny after identity proof. Crosby ("Hen") rides mail. Cook: Mat. Frogs in corral pond: "Go 'round! Knee deep!"
- **Pop Hayes**: saloon owner in Hastings, sleeps, sighs, "lean on yourself" sign; 50 years of hot springs; Andy's owner.
- **Charley James**: general store owner in Hastings, cribbage/solitaire, 60 yrs old, fishing partner of Pop.
- **Tom Quigley**: leader of rustlers, owns QE ranch in Twin Buttes sink; formerly CL cattle; enemy. Arm wounded (by Johnny). Dies (Johnny's bullet? actually killed by his own shot in struggle with Johnny at creek; Johnny turned muzzle; Quigley shot in side, dies) — "All but th' cows" line.
- **Jim Ackerman** ("Red Shirt" sometimes): gunman, rustler, relative of Quigley. Ivory-handled gun. Humiliated by Johnny in Hastings (kicked, gun taken). Later left alone; Johnny knifed/shot him at horse-tied scene, Ackerman killed by Johnny. Ackerman's gun held by Pop.
- **Art Fleming** ("Dan'l Boone", Ben?): rustler; shot/ killed by Luke's knife (throat), skunk incident.
- **Ben Gates** ("Benjamin Franklin Gates"): rustler; hit Johnny; cougar shot; fell into trapdoor? (no, Gates falls into water-bucket trapdoor, actually cook falls) — Gates wounded by Johnny at trail; survives.
- **Nat Harrison**: rustler; shot in arm; falls off cliff to death on trail night of Johnny's ambush.
- **Frank Holbrook**: rustler; slid down trail, fled with boots; sitting on top Twin; grizzly visit; Johnny kills grizzly with Sharp's.
- **Purdy**: rustler; wounded in head.
- **Sanford**: rustler with Sharp's; Johnny sees "red shirt".
- **Cookie** (QE cook): chicken-thief coyote feud.
- **Long Pete Carson**: ex-Circle S, fired; joins Ackerman; killed by Harrison/Gates from behind rock on creek trail (shot by Harrison? Gates/Harrison). Pete's dream of ranch.
- **Luke Tedrue**: oldest CL hand, ex-scout, ex-pony-express, carries old .44 Remington "Old Betsy" and knife "Colonel Bowie" (from hoof file). Helps Johnny. Calls Johnny and himself "two ijuts".
- **Mat**: CL cook.
- **Pete Wilson**: Tin Cup puncher mentioned.

## Places
- Hastings: cow-town; Pop's saloon (two-story front, blue panes, red sashes); Charley's store.
- CL ranch: Deepwater valley, east of Barrier, corral with frog pond, bunkhouse, cook shack.
- Deepwater River: swift, cold, ford between CL and Hastings; secret ford used by rustlers.
- Barrier: limestone ledge wall; Big Canyon and Little Canyon are breaks.
- Twin Buttes: two twin mesas (north and south Twin); Johnny's cabin in Nelson's valley/creek; pasture walled, trail up crevice; cabin burned.
- QE ranch: Quigley's sink (13 mi long, 8 wide), rustler houses (three stone houses, entrance canyon ~half mile long), corral; exits: 3 canyons; Humpback Butte; hidden canyon northwest.
- Devil's Gap ford; Circle S, Long T ranches (Smith), Bitter Creek hills, Rocky Ford.
- Tin Cup (Montana) Johnny's old ranch; Bar-20 (Texas).

## Major events in order
1. Johnny sings "Cowboy's Lament", ambushed on lava ridge; escapes; rides to Hastings. Pop sells him .45 cartridges; Andy the parrot bites/drinks; Johnny says Logan's CL ranch to work for; Johnny's "Dearly Beloved" horse name.
2. Johnny at CL; Logan suspects he is Logan-lookalike; identity proof via Cassidy's letter (red undershirt, William Junior, Pete's $8, etc.). Hired at $70/month.
3. Two weeks riding; Logan's rustler problem; frogs "Go 'round!". Johnny quits CL, acts as prospector (to scout Twin Buttes).
4. Johnny sees Pop; buys prospector gear from Charley (fishhooks, axe "Little Gem", etc.). Gold found; fish caught. Pop/Charley quarrel over eight-pound trout.
5. Johnny builds cabin in creek valley north of Hastings; finds rustlers' house; moonlight recon from plateau edge; wolf encounter.
6. Johnny's rope lowered into rustler valley; horse Pepper finds saddle; rustlers Ackerman and Fleming watch.
7. Quigley's council: cows rebranded CL→QE; Ackerman's note "Vamose" on door.
8. Johnny in Hastings: Ackerman tries to ambush; Johnny beats him and takes his gun; leaves Ackerman's Colt with Pop.
9. Night skirmish at cabin: Johnny kills Ben? (sentry killed by Johnny), panther shot by Gates, Harrison wounded, Johnny steals pants and Colts; fights cougar.
10. Johnny moves camp to southern Twin area; scouts Quigley's valley; QE brand; cow trail.
11. Night cattle raid; rustlers swim Deepwater; Johnny follows.
12. Ackerman leaves to hunt Johnny; meets Long Pete at creek; Pete joins.
13. Johnny ambushes Ackerman; Ackerman kills? — Ackerman dies; Johnny's horse loose; Johnny at canyon; Ackerman draws, killed by Johnny.
14. Johnny's camp on southern Twin; rustlers seek him; Long Pete shot by Harrison/Gates.
15. Blindman's Buff: Harrison falls off cliff; Gates wounded; Gates returns to ranch.
16. Johnny sleeps; skunk incident (Fleming); trapped on butte; climbs up trail; treed; Holbrook's climb; Johnny shoots rocks.
17. Grizzly bear attacks Johnny on butte; Johnny kills it with Sharp's.
18. Luke Tedrue arrives; Johnny and Luke ("two ijuts") plan; Quigley shot in arm; Fleming dead (Luke's knife).
19. Night attack: Luke diverts water ditch; Johnny fights Quigley in creek; Quigley shot, dies. Johnny and Luke return on Pepper: "All but th' cows."

Stylistic notes: dialect speech; profanity written as "d--n", "h--l".
